targetText: We have shown, in the course of our argumentation, that the realization of Socialism does not imply arbitrary destruction and construction, but a process of historical evolution.
summary: In his conclusion, Bebel emphasizes that socialism is the necessary outcome of historical evolution rather than arbitrary utopian invention, calling upon working women and men to unite in the struggle to emancipate humanity from class and sex slavery.
